items.title: Foundation and delivery system
items.scope: Scaffold, architecture, permissions baseline, AI workflows and documentation.
acceptance: Demo runs without credentials and planned modules are explicit.
SQL rejects cross-campaign access and player resource edits.
Repository guidance, skills, role definitions, hooks and backlog are executable/documented.
Production subpath navigation and responsive browser checks pass.

items.title: Identity and session lifecycle
sources: User: Google-only open registration and campaign hub
items.scope: Google sign-in/out, identity-scoped session/cache lifecycle and PKCE callback; no email allowlist or gameplay.
acceptance: Use Google with open registration, no email allowlist and no password screen.
Signed-out, loading, expired, invalid callback and retry states are usable.
User change cancels requests and clears private cached data.
HashRouter and Pages base survive auth redirects; logs contain no tokens.
validation: Mobile sign-in and sign-out browser tests

items.title: Campaign membership and invitations
sources: User: multi-campaign hub, in-app invitations and multiple DMs
items.scope: Campaign hub, creation/selection, seven-day in-app email invitations, multiple DMs, handover and non-destructive removal; no email notifications. Character-targeted invitations and assignment extend this flow in RYT-003 (ADR 004).
acceptance: Creator becomes DM atomically.
Invites expire and cannot be replayed or escalated to DM.
Revoked users lose access without deleting characters; protect last DM and immutable creator attribution with no permanent creator privileges.
DMs invite Players, promote/demote/remove members; members can leave after appointing a DM successor when needed.
A user in two campaigns never mixes private cache or records.

items.title: Characters and DM resource control
sources: User: DM creates characters and invites a Player to one character per campaign
User 2026-10-28: whole gold, food rations, water rations and account-home navigation
items.scope: DM-created unassigned characters, character-targeted invitations with atomic Player assignment, and revision-checked whole-gold/water-ration/food-ration/manual-exhaustion operations. One assigned character per Player per campaign initially; multiple characters and activation/deactivation are deferred. Includes requested RYT-001/002 account-home, navigation and settings UX.
acceptance: Homebrew uses whole gold, food rations, water rations and manual exhaustion; Spanish defaults with English available.
DM can create a character before its Player has an account or campaign membership, then invite an email for that specific unassigned character.
Invitation acceptance atomically activates Player membership and links the invited character; the Player cannot self-select or create a different character.

Database enforces at most one assigned character per Player per campaign and at most one assigned Player per character; reject cross-campaign links, already-assigned characters, duplicate assignments and expired/reused/revoked invitations, including concurrent acceptance.
Define DM-driven reassignment and preserve characters/resources when membership is revoked; no implicit transfer or character lifecycle/switcher feature.
Player can read own resources but never edit them directly.
DM editor uses RPC revision checks; revoke direct resource writes.
Audit every change; reject negative/unsafe integer values and stale revisions.
validation: SQL actor matrix, unassigned-character, one-to-one assignment and stale-write tests
Concurrent invitation acceptance and cross-campaign assignment denial tests
DM character creation to Player invitation/acceptance e2e, including a previously nonexistent account

items.title: Local and production database workflow
sources: User: define local and production database workflow in the next backlog item
User: connect localhost to a production-like PRE database and provide PROD-to-PRE schema/data ETL
User: use a clone schema pre in the same project, local targets pre and production remains public
items.scope: Prepare pre/pre_private in the existing Rytta Supabase project, pin local app traffic to pre and hosted production to public, and deliver an owner-only one-way bulk schema/data ETL with dry-run, transactional replacement, full PRE backups and restore.
acceptance: Local development and localhost previews use pre; hosted production uses public, with no editable browser schema override.
Clone public/private application tables, data, functions, triggers, foreign keys, grants and RLS into pre/pre_private; retain shared Auth without copying sessions or secrets.
Default ETL is a read-only plan; initial copy is explicit and replacement requires --replace-pre, retaining a full owner-only server-side PRE backup and transactional restore.
Maintenance remains inaccessible to anon, authenticated and service_role; application roles retain the source permission model.
Verify row equality, actor denials, PRE-only writes and backup/restore; fail closed on unsupported database objects rather than silently producing a partial clone.
Record setup, credentials, history, API schema exposure, refresh, recovery and shared-project limits in doctrine and evidence.
validation: Hosted PRE clone equality and rolled-back actor/isolation probes
PRE and public anonymous REST denials
PRE refresh/restore and environment selector regressions

items.title: Inventory, equipment and use/undo
items.scope: Item definitions, stacks, equipment slots, item use and compensating undo.
acceptance: Choose encumbrance variant and undo conflict/time policy.
Item icons have accessible pressable details, quantity and weight.
Use and undo are authorized/idempotent transactions, not snapshot restores.
Equipment constraints, empty inventory, retries and concurrent edits are covered.
validation: SQL double-use/undo denial and race tests

items.title: Merchants, purchases and sales
items.scope: DM merchants/stock/pricing and player transactions.
acceptance: Hidden merchants are absent from API responses for unauthorized players.
Prices and resale rates are server-derived; reject insufficient funds/stock.
Lock related records atomically and honor idempotency keys.
Simultaneous last-item purchases cannot double-spend; show actionable retry feedback.

items.title: Quest journal
items.scope: Visible campaign quests and DM status transitions.
acceptance: Hidden quest text never reaches player payload/cache.
DM can publish/advance quests and players see authorized changes.
Statuses and journal navigation work with keyboard and touch.

items.title: Shared combat overview
items.scope: Read-only shared HP/initiative with DM encounter controls.
acceptance: Define public HP visibility separately from private character data.
DM changes turn/order through authoritative operations.
Reconnect restores current state; no stale turn presented as current.
Table projection contains no DM secrets.

items.title: Rules and homebrew glossary
items.scope: Searchable conditions, spells, items and homebrew references.
acceptance: Select licensed sources and record attribution before import.
Keyword search covers aliases and shows useful empty states.
Homebrew visibility is authorized and text is rendered safely.

items.title: Campaign memories album
items.scope: Private campaign media, captions and published visibility.
acceptance: Private buckets and signed URLs enforce campaign ownership.
Validate file size/type; provide alt text and upload retry.
DM-only media never receives a public URL; define retention/deletion.

items.title: Atlas and travel planning discovery
items.scope: Choose lightweight map integration and travel rules before renderer work.
acceptance: Document image scale, terrain, movement/resource rules and supported gestures.
Compare coexistence/link-out with Owlbear to a small custom atlas.
Define marker visibility, route calculation tests and caching policy.
Produce an ADR and separately scoped implementation tickets.
validation: Representative route calculations and map prototype

items.title: Mano Hundida stronghold
items.scope: Stronghold treasury, staff, allies/enemies and scheduled upkeep.
acceptance: Model Mano Hundida as a campaign-owned stronghold.
Choose in-game time and upkeep/income cadence.
Period settlement is authorized, idempotent and auditable.
Separate treasury from personal inventory balances.

items.title: DM crafting and relationships
items.scope: Discover crafting costs/results and character relationship visibility.
acceptance: Define recipe, ingredient, outcome and failure rules with the group.
Specify DM-only versus shared relationships.
Split crafting transactions and relationship editor into deliverable tickets.

items.title: Realtime and recovery
items.scope: Scoped subscriptions, reconnect/refetch and truthful network state.
acceptance: Publish only approved tables/channels; RLS remains authoritative.
Invalidate scoped query keys; remove channels on campaign/identity change.
Offline/stale/reconnecting states are visible; no automatic economic replay.
Refetch on reconnect and foreground without private-data leakage.

items.title: Legacy import discovery
items.scope: Document formats and design validated dry-run import; no automatic migration.
acceptance: Inventory format versions from user-approved samples without changing legacy files.
Validate size/schema/content, map ownership and sanitize imported text.
Show dry-run report, backup plan and rollback before live import.
Create separate implementation tickets after format evidence.

items.title: Live companion release readiness
items.scope: Staging verification, accessibility, backup/restore and deployment evidence.
acceptance: Exercise real Supabase Auth/PostgREST/RLS/Realtime with multiple accounts.
Verify mobile Safari on a real supported device plus Chromium/tablet.
Verify Spanish/English coverage and preference persistence across live campaign flows.
Test backup/restore, public Pages URL, error reporting and rollback.
Resolve all blocking findings; publish only with explicit authorization.

items.title: Appearance, localization and independent UI/UX review
sources: User: dark/light, Spanish/English and UI/UX reviewer
items.scope: Persistent dark/light and ES/EN preferences for the scaffold, semantic palettes and a required independent UI/UX review workflow.
acceptance: Fresh visits default to dark and Spanish regardless of OS/browser preferences.
Users can choose theme/language; preferences survive routes and reloads.
All scaffold UI, accessible labels, loading/errors and document language/title are localized; user content is preserved.
Both themes/languages pass contrast, touch, keyboard and responsive checks.
The ui-ux role is invoked after interface changes and returns a recorded independent verdict.

items.title: Account shell and member character assignment
sources: User: right-side settings and account controls; member character assignment; DM Player preview; disable unfinished modules
items.scope: Separate global settings and account controls, move character assignment to membership, add a read-only Player presentation preview and disable unfinished navigation.
acceptance: Header shows campaign name, account control and right-side settings drawer; settings open in a centered large modal.
Member management lists character names without resources and supports invite, link and unlink. Character page only creates characters and edits resources.
DM preview changes presentation only and prevents DM controls; real authorization remains in SQL.
Unimplemented modules are disabled in camp and navigation; account home is reached through account control.

items.title: Campaign home and compact settings menu
sources: User: four browser comments on duplicate account panel, campaign invitation UX, oversized hamburger drawer and theme icons
items.scope: Remove the duplicate account block from campaign home, improve invitation hierarchy and states, replace the settings drawer with a compact anchored menu and show accessible moon/sun theme choices.
acceptance: Campaign home has no duplicate account/logout panel; account-menu logout remains available.
Join-campaign invitations have clear pending/empty/loading/error states, recipient identity, refresh and working accept/decline actions.
The hamburger opens a content-sized menu containing Settings only; keyboard, outside click, Escape and modal focus restoration work.
Appearance uses moon/sun icons with localized accessible names, selected state and 44px targets.
Verify phone/tablet, both languages/themes, 150% text, reduced motion and independent ui-ux verdict.

items.title: Member cards, membership invites and Player POV preview
sources: User: unlink on kick; characters on member cards; invite without character; impersonate Player POV
items.scope: Restructure members UI around per-member character lists with link/unlink, restore membership-only invitations, unlink characters when membership ends, and let DMs preview as a chosen Player.
acceptance: Removing or leaving a campaign unlinks that member's characters while preserving resources.
Members page shows each member's characters and link/unlink on the card; no separate assignment section.
DM can invite a Google email to the campaign without assigning a character.
Player view lets the DM pick a Player and see that Player's character POV without changing SQL privileges.
